cd /workspace && timeout 300 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref, gen

def core_of(paths):
    agg=ref.aggregate([(tuple(p),1) for p in paths], set())
    _l,_r,final=ref.peel_naive(agg)
    return sorted({ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)}), final

def trial(name, paths, tries=200):
    cl, final = core_of(paths)
    o = gen.find_order(cl, final, random.Random(3), tries=tries)
    print('%-22s links=%d order=%s' % (name, len(cl), 'None' if o is None else 'ok'))

K=64
c=list(range(1,K+1))
# pure ring rotations
trial('ring64', [c[s:]+c[:s] for s in range(K)])
# ring + 1 chord
p=[c[s:]+c[:s] for s in range(K)] + [[1,3,5]]
trial('ring64+1chord', p)
# ring + chords at distance 2 only (cycle square-ish)
p=[c[s:]+c[:s] for s in range(K)] + [[i, i+2, i+4] for i in range(1,K-4)]
trial('ring64+d2chords', p)
# two rings sharing a couple of nodes
A=list(range(1,33)); B=list(range(32,65))
paths=[[A[s:]+A[:s] for s in range(len(A))], [B[s:]+B[:s] for s in range(len(B))]]
trial('two rings', [x for sub in paths for x in sub])
# ladder / grid: two parallel rings connected
trial('ring64 alternating', [c[s:]+c[:s] for s in range(K)] + [[i, i+2] for i in range(1,K-1)])
EOF
